negative_results: An observation with no source artifacts is refused: derived data must name the immutable raw artifacts they were derived from (ProvenanceError).
A one-byte change to any source artifact shifts its content hash, so the recomputed lineage hash no longer matches and verify_lineage returns False.
A missing clock binding caps evidence at E3 (software ceiling), below a physical measurement (E4), and keeps the claim class out of the measurement classes.
A missing calibration binding caps evidence below E4 the same way.
An artifact with empty raw bytes, or without an instrument_id or calibration_id, is refused at construction.
Every artifact and observation built here is software-mode, so none is a PHYSICAL_MEASUREMENT; refuse_synthetic_observation_as_physical raises for every record built by this phase.
A live wall-clock stamp is refused; epochs must be passed in, keeping the lineage hash reproducible.
reopening_test: Reopen P02 if a MeasurementArtifact can be mutated in place without changing its content_hash, if verify_lineage returns True for a tampered source artifact, if build_observation accepts an empty source-artifact set, if any observation built from software-mode artifacts is classified as a PHYSICAL_MEASUREMENT (evidence E4), or if a record can be stamped from a live clock read.
acceptance_checklist: r15/artifacts.py and r15/provenance.py implemented, extending r13.serialize and r15.claims (no duplicate truth systems).
MeasurementArtifact manifest conforms to measurement_artifact.schema.json; ObservationRecord conforms to observation_record.schema.json (validated in tests).
Content hash over raw bytes: one-byte change alters the hash; identical bytes hash identically; replay does not mutate the original.
Derivation lineage graph built from raw artifacts to observation; lineage hash reproducible; tamper of any artifact breaks it.
Missing any required binding caps evidence below PHYSICAL_MEASUREMENT via r15.claims.evidence_cap / EvidenceBindings.
Timestamps and epochs are passed in, never read from a clock; wall-clock stamping is refused.
REAL, REPLAY, SYNTHETIC, and FAULT_INJECTION modes are distinct; no synthetic artifact is ever a physical measurement.
Each module exposes a <name>_report() with claim_class, measured_here='nothing', physical_validation, verdict.
27 focused, negative, and determinism tests pass.
Privacy scan clean: synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs, no personal names or absolute paths.

claims.statement: A MeasurementArtifact carries its raw bytes and a SHA-256 content hash over exactly those bytes; it is immutable and its manifest conforms to measurement_artifact.schema.json.

An ObservationRecord binds a reported value to its instrument, calibration, specimen, fixture, protocol, clock, environment, timestamps, uncertainty, immutable raw artifacts, and a hashed derivation lineage.
A one-byte change to any source artifact breaks the observation's lineage hash, and derived data with no source artifacts are refused.
Missing any required binding (calibration, clock, raw artifact, and so on) caps the evidence below a physical measurement via r15.claims.evidence_cap.
Every artifact and observation produced here is a deterministic synthetic fixture, capped at SYNTHETIC_OBSERVATION; no physical measurement is performed and no PHYSICAL_MEASUREMENT is claimed.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs
